title: Cross-System Consequence Routing, Recovery & Domain Adapter Runtime
objective: Implement the central MSWI fan-out runtime over the sealed MSWI-01 integration core: versioned ConsequenceRouteDefinition registration, dry-run SystemicConsequenceEnvelope construction, independently authoritative target-owner validation/commit adapters, SystemicPropagationReceipt persistence, bounded route-depth/cycle/deduplication/conflict controls, explicit inverse/compensation/restoration/irreversible recovery classes, delayed Project/Time/Event follow-up, and residual adapters for accepted doctrine/social, profession/life, pursuit/performance and grand-Project outputs without recreating those owner runtimes.
acceptance: Consequence route definitions bind exact source and target owner/domain versions and route applicability never grants target-domain authority.

SystemicConsequenceEnvelope is dry-run/proposal state that records exact route versions, candidate target operations, blocked/unresolved routes, cycle/deduplication decisions, visibility-safe explanations and staleness without proving a consequence occurred.

Every target owner independently validates and commits its own operation; SystemicPropagationReceipt records attempted, committed, rejected and blocked outcomes plus resulting owner Event IDs and versions.
Stable deduplication keys, explicit route-depth limits and cycle detection prevent unbounded automatic reaction cascades.
Conflicting target requests use the target-owner conflict policy or remain unresolved; MSWI never silently chooses canonical owner state.
Inverse operations, compensation, restoration workflows and irreversible results remain distinct, and recovery never deletes committed Event history.
Delayed consequences use Project/Time/Event authority and Campaign time rather than wall-clock scheduling or a second MSWI project ledger.
Residual adapters consume accepted doctrine/social, profession/life, pursuit, performance and grand-Project results without reimplementing those specialist runtimes.
Permission filtering occurs before route counts, search, diagnostics, explanation, AI context and export.
Blocking routing/recovery workflows remain semantic/textual, keyboard-capable, provider-off, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSWI-01 and all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
World, Environment, Organization, Economy, Character, Creature, Vehicle/Base and other target owners retain canonical mutation authority.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history.
Project/Time owns delayed and long-running follow-up; MSWI does not create a second scheduler or Project ledger.
Religion/Culture/Organization, DPL, GPR pursuit/performance and other specialist owners retain their own runtimes; MSWI consumes accepted results only.
Automatic fan-out is bounded, permission-filtered and attributable; no route may bypass target-owner validation.
MSWI-04 and later MSWI tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSWI-03 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the public MSWI-03 consequence-route/envelope/propagation seam, then implement only bounded routing, target-owner validation/commit adaptation, cycle/deduplication/conflict controls, recovery classes, delayed follow-up and residual owner adapters.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started MSWI-03 from completed_verified MSWI-01.
